fixed_metric: The exact phase-zero R767 full material map, including both nonplanar crowns and the true two-chart material overlaps; each optimizer and both refinements use this one target.

geometry.grip: all R767 fixed right head central points
geometry.exact_geometry: R770 original closed partial-isometry family with held unchanged; arbitrary fitted fields require their own full positive-phase geometry.

limits: Six independently fitted actual finite fields; the best in EACH named reference-polarization family receives all 4,8,16 fixed-time refinements. The final fields in both families release all three Gram rows and can themselves be non-even.

The fixed central field and grip remain exact and all positive-phase outer rim/cap charts share genuine three-channel world displacements with the bridges. Fitted meridians are evaluated on all three metric entries. The reference alone has analytic unit speed.

The time interpolation, fixed intrinsic sphere and phase interval agree at every level. Defining integrals are the full R767/R770 expressions; quadrature approximation is reported at each physical order.
All pointwise bounds, intersections and directed distances, unless separately proved, are finite samples. Raw coefficients and fourteen compressed PLY files remain on the same runner.
